headline: Grand Theft Auto VI priced at $79.99 for standard edition
summary: Rockstar Games announces preorder details and digital extras for the highly anticipated title, set to launch November 19th.
details: Grand Theft Auto VI will launch on November 19th for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. The standard edition is priced at $79.99, with the Ultimate Edition costing $99.99. Preorders begin tonight, offering digital or physical copies, though physical editions will include a download code.

Players who preorder or purchase before November 20th will receive the Vintage Vice City Pack, featuring a classic car, outfits, hairstyles, and a weapon skin. Digital preorders also include a free month of Rockstar's GTA Plus subscription.
The Ultimate Edition bundles exclusive in-game extras throughout the story, such as unique vehicles, weapons, outfits, and tattoos, along with access to exclusive in-game stores.

This announcement comes after significant speculation regarding the game's price, amidst a general trend of rising game costs in the industry. Some publishers have already increased prices for new releases.

The release of GTA VI marks over a decade since its predecessor, GTA V. The game's launch date has been adjusted previously, and its immense anticipated impact has led other major game developers to schedule their releases to avoid direct competition.
